newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southern Star lists at 25 pct premium.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southern Star lists at 25 pct premium.

text.p: Shares in film and television production company, Southern Star Group Ltd, made their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange at A$1.75, a 25 percent premium to its issue price of A$1.40 per share.
Existing shareholders would continue to hold 55 percent of the company's issued capital of 95.65 million shares, with shares pursuant to the public offer totalling 45 percent or 43.00 million shares.
Television shows produced by the company include "Blue Heelers", "Police Rescue" and "Water Rats", all police shows, while feature movies include "The Sum of Us."
By 11.09 a.m. (0109 GMT), the shares were at A$1.80, up 40 censt on the issue price on turnover of 1.4 million shares.
